newsitem.title: USA: Tosco Los Angeles hydrocracker hit by fire.
newsitem.headline: Tosco Los Angeles hydrocracker hit by fire.

text.p: A fire hit and downed a hydrocracking unit early Thursday evening at Tosco Corp's newly-acquired refinery in Wilmington, California, local police and oil industry sources said Friday morning.
The fire started around 1745 local time/0145 GMT, and lasted between one and one half hours, Los Angeles Police officials said.
Police said there were no injuries resulting from the fire at the 25,000 barrel per day cracker.
Tosco officials were not immediately available to comment on operations at the 125,000 bpd refinery, which Tosco bought from Unocal Corp at the beginning of this month.
((-- Oliver Ludwig, New York Energy Desk, 1 212 859 1633))
